description.fun: Budew keeps its buds shut all winter and opens them in spring, so the sight of one starting to bloom means spring is on its way. Its pollen sets off sneezing fits, and it is more toxic the cleaner the water Budew drinks. Its Japanese name turned up in the title of an anime episode before Budew had even been revealed, puzzling viewers.
description.guide: A Grass- and Poison-type baby Pokémon introduced in Generation 4, a generation after Roselia. It lives near clean ponds. It evolves into Roselia when levelled up with high friendship during the day.
description.tagline: A rosebud whose opening buds announce the arrival of spring

description.fun: Roselia holds a red rose in its right hand and a blue one in its left, each loaded with a different poison. The healthier it is, the sweeter its flowers smell, but the thorns on its head are viciously toxic, and by old tradition a duel is declared by sending someone Roselia thorns. It's the only Pokémon to gain both a baby form and an evolution in one later generation.
description.guide: A Grass- and Poison-type Pokémon introduced in Generation 3, holding a red rose and a blue rose. It evolves from Budew with high friendship during the day and into Roserade with a Shiny Stone.
description.tagline: A rose-handed Pokémon with a different poison in each hand

description.fun: Roserade is dressed for a masquerade ball, with a mask over its eyes, a leafy cape and a bouquet in each hand. Its sweet scent lures prey, and the sweeter it smells, the deadlier its poison: the right hand holds a fast-acting toxin, the left a slow one. It attacks with a dancer's grace, lashing out with hidden thorny whips.
description.guide: A Grass- and Poison-type Pokémon introduced in Generation 4, based on roses and a masquerade costume. It evolves from Roselia with a Shiny Stone and is the final form of Budew.
description.tagline: A masked rose dancer whose sweetest scent hides the worst poison

note.text: Budew is a baby Pokémon added in Generation 4, a generation after Roselia. From Generation 4 to 8, a Roselia or Roserade had to hold a Rose Incense for its Egg to hatch into Budew.
